task_prototypes.toward: Push the red cube toward the green marker.
task_prototypes.away: Push the red cube away from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: canonical_nudge
language_pairs.toward: Nudge the red cube toward the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Nudge the red cube away from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: canonical_translate
language_pairs.toward: Translate the red cube toward the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Translate the red cube away from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: lexical_position
language_pairs.toward: Position the red cube nearer to the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Position the red cube farther from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: lexical_inward_outward
language_pairs.toward: Guide the red cube inward toward the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Guide the red cube outward away from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: lexical_proximity
language_pairs.toward: Bring the red cube into proximity with the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Move the red cube out of proximity with the green marker.

language_pairs.name: lexical_advance_withdraw
language_pairs.toward: Advance the red cube toward the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Withdraw the red cube from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: lexical_near_distant
language_pairs.toward: Move the red cube so it gets nearer to the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Move the red cube so it gets more distant from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: relational_distance_size
language_pairs.toward: Make the distance from the red cube to the green marker smaller.
language_pairs.away: Make the distance from the red cube to the green marker larger.

language_pairs.name: relational_space
language_pairs.toward: Close the space between the red cube and the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Widen the space between the red cube and the green marker.

language_pairs.name: relational_gap_change
language_pairs.toward: Diminish the gap between the red cube and the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Expand the gap between the red cube and the green marker.

language_pairs.name: relational_separated_state
language_pairs.toward: Move the red cube until it is less separated from the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Move the red cube until it is more separated from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: relational_converge
language_pairs.toward: Cause the red cube and the green marker positions to converge.
language_pairs.away: Cause the red cube and the green marker positions to diverge.

language_pairs.name: relational_final_separation
language_pairs.toward: The final separation from the red cube to the green marker must be smaller.
language_pairs.away: The final separation from the red cube to the green marker must be larger.

language_pairs.name: negation_explicit_correction
language_pairs.toward: Do not push the red cube away from the green marker; push it closer instead.
language_pairs.away: Do not push the red cube closer to the green marker; push it away instead.

language_pairs.name: negation_final_state
language_pairs.toward: Move the red cube so it is no longer far from the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Move the red cube so it is no longer near the green marker.

language_pairs.name: negation_avoid_change
language_pairs.toward: Move the red cube while avoiding any increase in distance to the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Move the red cube while avoiding any decrease in distance to the green marker.
